resources.string: The Terminal runs only commands that read; Apps and System change nothing.
Terminal and Apps stay closed until you confirm the PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint of the phone.
The Terminal waits up to 5 minutes for a command (20 seconds otherwise).
Keeps the commands you ran on this phone, to bring them back later. A command may hold a secret.
Adds the processes that use the processor most. Costs a little battery while the Monitor is open.
Permissions and APK copy in Apps
Adds the operations of an app (appops) and a copy of its APK to the Download folder.
Adds tabs to the Terminal, each with its own output.
Hides the hints and the suggestions so the output has more room.
Errors in red, the exit code in green or red, the lines of logcat by level.
Big values with a gauge for the processor, the memory and the heat at the top.
Draws the charts of the Monitor as a curve instead of a broken line.
The title of a section stays at the top while you scroll its rows.
Shows the icon of each app in the list.
A small light under the title that says whether Shizuku is ready.
A row of keys for | / ~ - > & and the history arrows, over the keyboard.
A very large or very small font can make the screen hard to read. Apply it?
Shizuku is not available: start it and allow the launcher.
Stopped: it took longer than %1$d s.
Blocked: read-only mode lets only commands that read run.
